content: User decision 2026-10-02. A German rule reports only when its measured point precision is above 0.7. At or below 0.7 the rule goes off. Above 0.7 it observes. Enforce still needs a Wilson lower bound of 0.85 (Q23). banned_dash and spaced_hyphen stay family-gated, the em dash ban stands. Unmeasured rules stay unchanged.
title: German rules report only above 0.7 precision
